name: Lyra Residences

I matched its road pattern (a junction where a NW-SE road meets an east-west road leading to a gated villa cluster; plot on the junction's NE side, directly west of a house with an orange roof) against Esri satellite imagery and OSM (Thimonia bakery at 35.05907, 33.96648). Read off the imagery: about 35.0589, 33.9635. Medium confidence, accuracy about +/-30 m; not derived from a GPS tag or a developer pin. facts: Lyra Residences is an off-plan apartment building on plot 530 in Deryneia, Famagusta district; planning permission was issued on 29 November 2024.
The building has seven apartments on three residential floors above a ground-floor parking level, on a 522 m² plot; maximum height 13.5 m.
The first and third floors each have two two-bedroom apartments of about 75-75.7 m² internal area with a 20.19 m² covered veranda.
The second floor has three one-bedroom apartments of about 50.5-52 m² internal area with verandas of 11.27-17.9 m².
Parking for 7 cars plus one accessible space is at ground level under the building; each private space has a provision for an EV charger.
The building has an A-class energy performance certificate, 250 mm thermal clay-brick external walls with an external insulation system, and thermally broken aluminium frames with double glazing.
Kitchens have laminate units with soft-close mechanisms and large-format porcelain worktops and backsplashes; bathrooms have concealed wall-hung WCs and shower channel drains.
A 2 kWp photovoltaic system serves the communal areas; hot water comes from a roof solar system with an 800-litre tank and 150-litre cylinder.
The developer states: nearest beach 4 km, restaurants and cafés 500 m, supermarkets 800 m, Deryneia centre 1 km, school 1 km, private hospital 3-4 km, Paralimni Marina 9 km, Larnaca Airport 48 km.

conflicts: Not a conflict but a naming risk: we already list a different 'Lyra' (another developer, Paphos). This draft is named 'Lyra Residences' and all texts say Deryneia/Famagusta.

Larnaca Airport distance: the Lyra presentation says 48 km, while the developer's Thea Residences materials (same town, Deryneia) say 38 km. Text uses the Lyra figure (48 km) as stated for this project.

Parking: the price list says covered parking; the permit ground plan labels some of the 8 spaces as open-air (ΥΠΑΙΘΡΙΟΙ). Price list wins; the developer may want to confirm which apartments get covered spaces.
All 19 images in the share are 3D renders (the presentation marks them 'artist impressions'); no real photos.
Developer's website: no Lyra project page; media library has lyra-exterior.jpg (1200x760) and three 380x280 interior thumbnails uploaded 10 Nov 2026 - nothing better than the share.
